一直.consejo: With it, it indicates moving without turning.

前.consejo: You can indicate the position or address.

拐.consejo: It is used when describing a change of direction.

直走.consejo: Instruction to move forward without turning.

往左.consejo: It indicates the direction to the left side.

往右.consejo: It indicates the direction to the right side.

十字路口.consejo: Intersection where four streets are located.

离.en: be at a distance from; from
离.consejo: It is used in the)) /) to express distance.

找.consejo: You can express the action of looking for something or someone.

texto: **往** is placed before a direction or place: **一直** means «all straight» or «continuamente».
To give an instruction, you can say **往前走** («Keep going forward.») or **在路口右拐** («turn right at the crossing»).

frases.zh: 到 路口, 请 左拐.

frases.en: When you get to the crossing, turn left, please.
